ResearchProjectDef.label: countermeasure
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a permanent brain implant attaches to the medial prefrontal cortex, artificially inducing trauma savant-like symptoms. It greatly enhances the user's manipulation abilities at the cost of reduced sociability. This implant cannot be removed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: titanium skeleton
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant that reinforces the outer compact bone and the endosteum with titanium and plasteel, reducing incoming damage at the cost of mobility. It is surrounded by a lattice-dust healing system that allows it to recover from damage.
